name: What are common causes of fence-post damage in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: What are common causes of fence-post damage in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the East Bay, common causes of fence-post damage include rot due to moisture exposure, especially at the ground line, and insect infestation like termites. Weather conditions, such as strong winds and heavy rains, can also weaken posts over time. Additionally, general wear and tear, accidental impacts, and improper installation can contribute to post deterioration. The humid climate in some areas can accelerate wood rot.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common causes of fence-post damage in the East Bay include rot from moisture, insect infestation, weather, wear and tear, and improper installation.
